claims.object_text: DNA repair factor possessing both 5'-kinase and 3'-phosphatase activities
claims.quote: Polynucleotide kinase-phosphatase (PNKP) is a DNA repair factor possessing both 5'-kinase and 3'-phosphatase activities to modify ends of a DNA break prior to ligation.
Recently, decreased PNKP levels were identified as the cause of severe neuropathology present in the human microcephaly with seizures (MCSZ) syndrome.

claims.object_text: defective base excision repair and non-homologous end-joining
claims.quote: This severe phenotype involved defective base excision repair and non-homologous end-joining, pathways required for repair of both DNA single- and double-strand breaks.
